prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users experience their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in has drop-off and support received 8 emails regarding missing/reset pets when signing in prior to adoption.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Overview Screen: Add a dedicated onboarding screen right before home intro explaining desktop mouse gestures and hotkeys. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with the desktop pet after setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Generation Waiting Progress Tips: Display rotating tips and desktop pet trivia while waiting for pet assets to assemble. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and median 201s, leading to drop-offs during processing.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Warning Hint: Add an explicit sign-in hint explaining that using the same account method restores existing pets. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts so users are notified when pet generation finishes. (why: Users wait over 3 minutes on average during generation and abandon the app while running in the background.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Confirmation: Reformat adoption certificate into a split card layout with side-by-side pet summary and confirmation. (why: Adoption conversion rate is 60.9%; a side-by-side summary streamlines final confirmation.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Placement Launch Guidance: Update home_intro text with clear instructions on where to look on screen if the pet icon is minimized. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open visibly after setup.)
